tables.name: Something goes wrong
rows: The floor tilts {1d4} degrees and everything round starts rolling toward the exit.
A camera drone gets stuck in someone's hair and will not leave.
The lights go out for {1d6} seconds. When they come back, one door is gone.
A sponsor jingle starts playing at full volume and will not stop until someone finds the speaker.
Something in the walls starts knocking back whenever anyone talks.
A pipe bursts. The water is warm, smells of soup and rises {1d3} inches a minute.
A rival team runs through, shouting a warning nobody understands, and is gone.
The exit sign now points in a direction that does not exist.
A tiny monster is following the party and pretending very hard not to be.
The ceiling lowers by a foot. Then it waits, as if thinking about it.
An announcer voice reads out one character's most embarrassing moment. Ratings jump.
The air turns to glitter. Breathing is fine; seeing is not.

tables.name: Fight twist
rows: Reinforcements: {1d4} more of the weakest enemy burst out of a wall.
The floor cracks. Next round, a 10-foot section collapses into a pit.
A sponsor drops a small box between the two sides. Whoever grabs it gets one healing item.
The biggest enemy panics and tries to flee, dropping something shiny.
A rival crawler shows up, watches for one round and then picks a side.
The lights strobe: all attacks this round have disadvantage, the audience loves it.
An enemy shouts a name. One of them is clearly the leader, kill it and the rest waver.
Fire starts in a corner and spreads one square a round.
The music changes to a boss theme. Nothing else happens. Yet.
An enemy surrenders and offers information for its life.

tables.name: In the background
rows: The leaderboard updates: someone the party knows dropped {1d10} places.
An admin broadcast reminds everyone that the next floor closes in {2d6} hours.
A huge screen shows another team failing spectacularly. The crowd laughs for a full minute.
A rumour spreads that a secret shop has opened somewhere on this floor.
Somewhere far away, a boss roars. Everyone pretends they did not hear it.
The show cuts to an ad for a soda nobody has ever tasted.
A voting poll opens: "Which crawler deserves a prize?" The party is on it.
A maintenance crew of tiny robots walks past, carrying a door.

tables.name: Safe room event
rows: The bartender is new and asks for everyone's favourite drink, then gets it wrong on purpose.
A crawler from another team sits down and asks if the party wants to trade.
The TV in the corner shows a replay of the party's last fight, with commentary.
Someone is selling "lucky" rocks. One of them might actually be lucky.
A fan letter arrives for the least popular character. It is a little creepy.
The shower works for once. There is a queue.
A quiet stranger pays for a round and asks about the party's next floor.
A food fight breaks out between two other teams.

tables.name: What else is in the box
rows: A note from the sponsor: "Use it well. Or badly. Both rate well."
{1d20} gold coins and a stale cookie.
A trading card of the crawler who opened the box. It is not flattering.
Packing peanuts that hum quietly when nobody is looking.
A coupon for one free hug from the next monster. Probably not valid.
A tiny paper crown. Wearing it does nothing, but the audience cheers.

rows.text: A pressure plate: darts, {1d6} damage, check to notice.
A net drops from the ceiling. Stuck until someone cuts it.
The floor turns to slide. Everyone ends up {2d6}×5 feet further down the corridor.
A fake treasure chest with teeth.
A sign: "Do not press". There is no button. The sign is the trap.

tables.name: Dungeon mood
rows: Cold, damp, and the drip is somehow always on your neck.
Warm and sticky like a gym nobody cleaned.
Dead silent. Even footsteps sound muffled.
Windy. There should not be wind down here.
Smells of fresh bread. Suspicious.
A low hum that makes teeth itch.

tables.name: NPC motive
rows: wants out of the dungeon and will do almost anything for a map
wants revenge on a team that left them behind
wants to be famous and keeps looking for the cameras
wants to sell something they absolutely should not have
wants a friend and is bad at showing it
wants the party to carry a package and not open it
wants to win a bet about the party
wants their stolen hat back

tables.name: NPC secret
rows: They are working for the show and report everything.
They know where the stairs are and lie about it.
They are much stronger than they look.
They owe money to someone dangerous.
They used to be a monster. Long story.
They have a box they cannot open alone.

tables.name: NPC quirk
rows: speaks only in questions
laughs before every sentence
keeps calling everyone by the wrong name
never stops eating
counts everything out loud
whispers the important parts

tables.name: System line for an odd moment
rows: The System has reviewed that decision and would like to file a complaint.
Achievement pending. The committee is laughing too hard to decide.
Reminder: the audience can see you. All of you. Always.
That was either genius or a cry for help. Ratings say: both.
Please do not lick the dungeon.
The System notes that this is not how doors work.

tables.name: Grind montage
rows: {1d4} hours of hunting small monsters. Everyone gains a little, someone gets bitten.
{1d6} hours of searching rooms. One good find and a lot of dust.
{1d3} hours training in a safe room. Sore muscles, one new trick.
{2d4} hours of wandering lost. Morale drops, the map improves.

tables.name: Quick NPC (one line)
rows: [[crowd_species]] who [[npc_motive]], and [[npc_quirk]].

tables.name: Look
rows: {name} is a {species} in a suit two sizes too big, with a name tag that says something else
{name}, a tall {species}, has a bandaged hand and very clean boots
{name} is a cheerful {species} covered in sponsor stickers
{name} is a nervous {species} who keeps checking the exits
{name}, an old {species}, wears three hats stacked on top of each other
{name} is a {species} with a shiny new weapon and no idea how to hold it
{name}, a small {species}, carries a backpack bigger than they are
{name} is a {species} with a loud laugh and a missing front tooth

tables.name: Want
rows: Right now {name} wants a drink and someone to listen to a long story
{name} is looking for a team, any team, before the floor closes
{name} wants to sell a map and keeps lowering the price
All {name} cares about is finding a lost friend from another team
{name} wants to know which of you is the famous one
{name} is trying very hard to avoid someone in this room
{name} wants to win the bet about who dies first, and it involves you
{name} needs help carrying something heavy and will pay in rumours

tables.name: Hook
rows: Secret: they saw the boss of this floor and it limps on the left
They offer a free healing potion if you take a message to the next safe room
Rumour: the shop on this floor sells one item that should not exist
Voice tip: talks fast, ends every sentence with "you know?"
They say: "Don't trust the cat. Any cat. I mean it."
Secret: they are wanted by another team and will lie about their name
Offer: they will trade a key for something that makes them look tough
Voice tip: very slow, very polite, never blinks
